g.textArea: Pans to set out for the K4 day: packs short x pieces per pack, divided by pieces per pan, rounded up.

rect.data-description: LOOKUP (other sheet or table). One block per pan: the pan name, then every non-OBS product whose Pans/Boxes is that pan. =LET(pn,FILTER(Pans[Pans/Boxes],Pans[Pans/Boxes]<>""),sku,Products[No.],pan,Products[Pans/Boxes],gpg,Products[Gen. Prod. Posting Group],DROP(REDUCE("",pn,LAMBDA(a,p,LET(m,FILTER(sku,(pan=p)*(gpg<>"OBS"),""),IF(AND(ROWS(m)=1,INDEX(m,1)=""),a,VSTACK(a,p,m))))),1))
FORMULA (this sheet). =A411.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IF(OR([@Finished Product]="",[@Finished Product]=0),"",IF(ISNUMBER(MATCH([@Finished Product],Pans[Pans/Boxes],0)),"Pan",XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Asset])))

rect.data-title: Unique Dough (C), Daily Bags Per Mix (D)
rect.data-description: LOOKUP (other sheet or table). C =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Unique Dough],,0),""). D =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Unique Dough],UniqueDough[Dough],UniqueDough[Optimal Bag]),"").
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Description]),"").
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Pans[Pans/Boxes],Pans[Trays Per 1 bag Mix]),""). Filled on pan rows.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Pieces Per Tray/Case]),"").
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFERROR(XLOOKUP([@Finished Product],Pans[Pans/Boxes],Pans[Pieces Per Pan]),""). Filled on pan rows.
FORMULA (this sheet). Mislabelled copies: Sku =[@Today''s Date], Today's Date =[@Finished Product]. Both just repeat Finished Product.
NOT USED. A column literally named #N/A holding a copy of Demand. Nothing reads it.
NOT USED. Blank. Nothing reads them.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Packs (or cases) short on the K4 day: the same formula as Mix_Slice K. Blank on pan rows.
FORMULA (this sheet). =[@Pans].

FORMULA (this sheet). On pan rows: pieces needed by every product on that pan, divided by pieces per pan, rounded up. =IFERROR(IF([@Pans]<>"Pan","",ROUNDUP(SUMPRODUCT(--(XLOOKUP(Oven_Info[Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Pans/Boxes],"")=[@Finished Product]),IFERROR(--Oven_Info[Demand],0),IFERROR(--Oven_Info['# of pieces per tray/box],0))/[@Pieces Per Pan],0)),"") Feeds: MCS Schedule F29.

FORMULA (this sheet). Text list of each pan and its products: =LET(pn,FILTER(Pans[Pans/Boxes],Pans[Pans/Boxes]<>""),sku,Products[No.],dsc,Products[Description],pan,Products[Pans/Boxes],DROP(REDUCE("",pn,LAMBDA(a,p,VSTACK(a,p,FILTER(" "&sku&" - "&dsc,pan=p," (no products assigned)"),""))),1))
FORMULA (this sheet). =COUNTA(Pans[Pans/Boxes]) = 41 pans and boxes in the Pans table.

OUTPUT. Lists pans with something to set out when the product under the pan is on MCS LINE: =LET(p,Oven_Info[Pans],nm,Oven_Info[Finished Product],n,IFERROR(--Oven_Info['# of Pans/Boxes to set out],0),nx,DROP(VSTACK(p,""),1),FILTER(HSTACK(nm,n),(p="Pan")*(nx="MCS LINE")*(n>0),"No MCS pans"))

rect.data-title: Worked example: 3.5" Challah Onion Bun pan
rect.data-description: NOTE. Tuesday: F3082 is short 55 packs x 12 pieces = 660 pieces. 660 / 28 pieces per pan = 23.6, ROUNDUP = 24 pans to set out.
INPUT (typed). Mix-Slice-Oven!K4 = Tuesday. Demand is the K4 day, like Mix_Slice.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Pans/Boxes (which pan a product goes on), Pieces Per Tray/Case, Asset, Unique Dough, Description.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Pieces Per Pan and Trays Per 1 bag Mix for each pan or box.
OUTPUT. F29 on the MCS Schedule is the only formula that reads # of Pans/Boxes to set out. The Breadline Schedule has no pan list.
ISSUE. Pans are counted for Tuesday (K4) while headers print Saturday.

rect.data-title: F29 checks one product per pan
rect.data-description: ISSUE. The pan is listed only when the row right under it is an MCS LINE product; a pan whose first product is on another line is skipped.
ISSUE. Oven_Info has 86 rows for a 68-row list: 18 rows of #N/A (see Recon).
ISSUE. Rows 453 to 477 fall outside the print area.

ISSUE. Tuesday: (Grande) Large Croissant 8 pans, Mini Croissant 2, Mini Danish, Spinach Feta and Chocolate Croissant 1 each (3rd Party - Bake) are counted, but F29 lists MCS pans only and their rows are outside the print area.

flowchart LR classDef input fill:#B3E65F,stroke:#6E9A24,color:#2F440B classDef export fill:#B8ACFB,stroke:#8A7BE0,color:#231266 classDef calc fill:#9CE6FF,stroke:#2C97BB,color:#1C4657 classDef lookup fill:#FFB575,stroke:#CC7830,color:#542700 classDef output fill:#DDDDD8,stroke:#8A8A7E,color:#434339 classDef issue fill:#FFC6C6,stroke:#BD0A0A,color:#5C0A0A PANS["Pans table
Pieces Per Pan"]:::input PROD["Products
Pans/Boxes, pieces per tray/box"]:::input ROWS["A410 row list
each pan, then its products"]:::calc K4["K4 day selector"]:::input DSD["DSD_DSnD / Dist_DSnD
_Production for the K4 day"]:::lookup DEM["Demand H
packs short"]:::lookup PCS["pieces = Demand x
pieces per tray/box"]:::calc SUM["Pan row: SUMPRODUCT over
every product on that pan"]:::calc SET["# to set out =
ROUNDUP(pieces / Pieces Per Pan)"]:::calc F29["MCS Schedule F29
pan list"]:::output PANS --> ROWS PROD --> ROWS K4 --> DEM DSD --> DEM ROWS --> DEM DEM --> PCS PROD --> PCS PCS --> SUM SUM --> SET PANS --> SET SET --> F29
